title: Looking for Beta Testers: The First All-in-One AI Investment System (Get 50% Off for Life)
author: Express-Meringue-914
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/431ed0zgjfyh1.png

Hey r/investingforbeginners,

If you invest in U.S. equities, you know how fragmented the process is. You screen on one site, read SEC filings on another, track charts somewhere else, and manually execute trades via your broker. By the time you buy, your original investment thesis is buried across disconnected tabs and notes.

We built **Synaptix-Systems** to fix this. It is the first fully integrated, evidence-led investment lifecycle system of its kind, heavily driven by specialized AI agents.

We are officially launching our Private Beta for the **Share Portfolio Manager (SPM)**, and we want experienced investors and traders to test it, break it, and help us shape it.

What makes this system completely different?

Instead of a "black-box" AI that just spits out stock picks, Synaptix connects your entire workflow into one intelligent loop:

* **Stock Discovery & Scoring:** Instantly scan and rank universes using consistent Blend and Momentum scoring, alongside our "Growth A\*" fundamental acceleration lens.
* **Deep AI-Driven Research:** Our *Catalyst Scout* extracts exact source fragments and filing links from SEC documents, so you can see the hard facts behind every insight.
* **Smart Entry & RiskGate:** The system dynamically gauges market regimes and checks your portfolio heat, sector concentration, and account limits before an order moves forward.
* **Full Broker Integration:** Seamlessly connect and route your approved orders directly through Alpaca (with full paper trading mode available so you can practice safely).
* **Automated Portfolio Management:** Set your downside protection rules (hard stops, trailing controls, partial reductions) *before* the market tests your discipline.
* **Continuous Self-Learning (Daily Thesis Agent):** Every single day, an AI agent reviews your active holdings against your original thesis, ensuring you never lose track of why you bought a stock.

The Tester Perk (50% Off for Life)

Building a system this comprehensive takes a community. If you are accepted into the Private Beta and actively provide feedback, **you will qualify for a 50% discount on your subscription fees for as long as you use the system.**

How to Join:

1. Go to our portfolio page: [https://synaptix-systems.co.za/portfolio/](https://synaptix-systems.co.za/portfolio/)
2. Watch the brief walkthrough videos to see the live system functionality (Market Overview, Discovery, RiskGate, etc.).
3. Click the **"Apply for Beta"** button, fill out the short application form, and submit it.

We have a limited number of slots for this founding beta phase to ensure we can work closely with everyone's feedback. If you have any questions about the workflow, architecture, or AI agents, drop them below—I'll be hanging out in the comments to answer them!

*Disclaimer: For educational and informational purposes. Synaptix-Systems does not provide investment advice. Trading involves risk and only paper trading modes are used during the testing phase*

comments.author: Zealou-sidealIron
comments.body: Before anyone applies: is the track record of the system’s picks available anywhere, and is it live or only paper trading? Hard to judge a tool like this without seeing how its past signals actually did.

replies.author: Express-Meringue-914
replies.body: This new system is based on many years of experience. We are looking for people interested in trading and investing systems to test and help build this system into a tool that increases the probability of success. In private use, it has performed very encouragingly so far. It supports both Live and Paper trading for subscribers, but for testers we open only Paper trading.

comments.author: investigatormaker
comments.body:
Your post opens with "Hey r/investingforbeginners", but you're asking for experienced investors and traders here in r/ai_trading, so fix that greeting before readers take it as a blast. Testers will also ask how "Full Broker Integration" squares with the disclaimer about paper trading, so say plainly whether Alpaca orders stay in paper mode for the beta. I'd lead with one concrete thing, like Catalyst Scout showing the filing fragment behind an insight, instead of "first fully integrated". The trade-off: making people watch walkthrough videos before applying loses some casual readers, but it filters for the testers you want.
